#### 1. aplastic anemia  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.663)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-5685942, Reactome:R-HSA-912446, Reactome:R-HSA-9701192, Reactome:R-HSA-9709570, Reactome:R-HSA-9709603)

Loss-of-function mutations in RAD51 disrupt the homologous recombination DNA repair pathway, leading to genomic instability and cellular dysfunction that manifests as bone marrow failure (Fanconi Anemia) and aplastic anemia.

**How to falsify it:** The discovery of distinct, non-overlapping molecular pathways for Fanconi Anemia and aplastic anemia, not involving RAD51 or other shared DNA repair components, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Common variants in RAD51 (e.g., allele frequency >1% in gnomAD) that do not segregate with either disease.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of RAD51 in DNA repair for both Fanconi Anemia and aplastic anemia could inform therapeutic strategies. Targeting DNA repair pathways or enhancing DNA repair capacity in hematopoietic stem cells might offer novel treatment avenues for patients with either condition.
